name: KY-027 magic light cup
not_buildable: Its LED needs an output pin, and the vendor's tables disagree on its supply voltage.
identification: Small black PCB with a black cylinder lying flat, a clear LED standing upright and 4 angled header pins labelled G, +, S, L.

facts.statement: A tilt switch with an LED on the same board. The vendor wires it to 5 V on Arduino and Raspberry Pi and to 3.3 V on the Pico, and lists a 120 ohm series resistor for the LED at 3.3 V.
facts.source: Joy-IT SensorKit, KY-027, wiring tables and series resistor
